notes:
v0.3.35 - the memory figures are measured now, not guessed

FIXED: Local models said gemma4:e4b at 32K "won't fit - 15.2 GB". It loads in
3.26 GB, entirely on an 8 GB card. The old figure was an upper bound, and an
upper bound was being used to rule a setting out - it can prove something
fits, never that it doesn't. Two things made the bound so loose for this
model: an E4B doesn't load its vision and audio parts for text, so its file
size is about three times what it actually uses; and it only keeps part of the
conversation in memory, so a bigger context costs almost nothing.
